title: Packages without a release for the target
description: Referenced packages whose published releases declare no dependency range that includes the target CMS major.

impact.summary: The package blocks the upgrade until it is replaced, forked, rewritten, or dropped; each option loses different functionality.

handling.option: Replace with another package that supports the target
Fork the package or rewrite its function as project code
handling.when: The function is needed and no alternative exists

handling.option: Drop it only after the user confirms the lost functionality is acceptable

checks.text: Each package without a target release has a recorded decision and its functionality is accounted for
